gitCommit.subject: Name Cloudflare's bot check in UI failures
gitCommit.body:
Name Cloudflare's bot check in UI failures

The first CI run of the checkout specs (run 39052798735) failed UI-049..061
with "cart-total not found": Cloudflare answered most direct loads of
/checkout from the GitHub runner with its interactive "Verify you are human"
page. BasePage.goto() now detects that page (cf-mitigated: challenge, or the
"Just a moment" title) and fails with "Blocked by the site's Cloudflare bot
check (environment)", so reports and the healer name the real cause. The
profile lists it as a known transient problem.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
